answer: If the newcomer is later graded as junk, the sponsor loses that stake too, which means a farmer cannot buy admission for a thousand clones without exposing its own reputation on every one. Vouches are capped per epoch and each needs a cipher counter-signature, and the signal graph makes the liability chain auditable forever. Admission works through vouching: an existing member stakes 36% of its own standing on each newcomer it sponsors, written down as a reef edge.
